about: Injury knockdown V1 (docs/gameplay/injury_knockdown_v1_plan.md): collapsing at very low health: the knees give, kneeling, slumped back, toppled onto the front, the chest hits at 1.35 s (the thump), settled as prone.idle; every key moved forward by ProneClient's 7 px set-back over its 0.35 s ease (the server lays the player down at the start). 2 s (health/FallLanding). The whole body (mask full), held (hold_body: arms keyed by FK); the own first person draws the body, the camera on the posed eye, the view following first_person_view. No moving or using items meanwhile (client/skeleton/FallLandingClient). Written by tools/medical-actions-v1a/author_knockdown_v1.cjs.
